note: Trigger-routing suite, minted alongside artifact-rules 2026-08-17 (closes #619, LLD-0011). Positives are consult-only asks — a standards question arriving without a build verb, one per axis (design-system consumption, shell doctrine, mermaid house style, refresh procedure) plus two adjacent-phrasing repeats. Negatives fence the four siblings this capability overlaps trigger vocabulary with: make-artifact (the build ask itself), make-design-system (authoring/grading the token SOURCE), markdown-to-markup (plain markdown rendering), make-doc (drafting a functional document).
